# King's Clubhouse

> Not just a venue, A Destination. King's Clubhouse is a venue-hire clubhouse, bar, balcony, outdoor kitchen and open grounds at KCS Old Boys RFC, Arthur Road, Motspur Park, New Malden KT3 6LX — five minutes' walk from Motspur Park station. We host kids' parties, birthdays and celebrations, BBQs and cook-outs, formal dinners, wedding celebrations, tournaments and festivals, community events and corporate events.

Contact: info@kingsclubhouse.co.uk (email only — no phone line). Enquiries: https://kingsclubhouse.co.uk/#enquire

## Main pages

- [Home](https://kingsclubhouse.co.uk/): Overview of the venue, events we host, spaces, enquiry form, what's on, FAQ and directions
- [Spaces](https://kingsclubhouse.co.uk/#spaces): The Clubhouse, Outdoor Kitchen & Braai, Grounds & Marquee, The Pitches, and the Whole Venue
- [Events we host](https://kingsclubhouse.co.uk/#events): Kids' parties, milestone birthdays, black-tie marquee dinners, outdoor cinema, live music, Oktoberfest, match screenings
- [What's on](https://kingsclubhouse.co.uk/#calendar): Public events at the club, month by month
- [Enquire](https://kingsclubhouse.co.uk/#enquire): Ask for availability and a quote
- [FAQ & find us](https://kingsclubhouse.co.uk/#faq): Prices, deposits, bookings, weddings, food, timings, parking and directions

## Spaces

- The Clubhouse (upstairs): licensed bar, 200 standing / 100 seated, balcony for 100 overlooking the grounds
- The Outdoor Kitchen & Braai: gas grill, two braai pits, full countertops, room for three chefs; has fed 150 guests
- The Grounds & Marquee: marquee for up to 150 seated, May–August
- The Pitches: kids' rugby and touch tournaments, 7s, festivals, outdoor cinema; by arrangement, May–August; six changing rooms
- The Whole Venue: the run of the place for tournaments, festivals, weddings and big celebrations; full-day bookings

## Key facts

- Hire starts from £250; a bar minimum spend can replace the hire fee
- Bring your own caterer and entertainment
- Parking for around 100 cars; dogs welcome on a lead
- All events finish by 11pm
- Wedding celebrations and receptions only (no ceremonies), up to three a year — enquire at least six months ahead
- Every booking helps fund the development of the grounds
